description_en: Modifies the configuration of a Virtual Border Router (VBR)
description_zh: 调用ModifyVirtualBorderRouterAttribute接口修改边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）的配置
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-virtual-border-router-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-id vbr-bp1lhl0taikrte0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVirtualBorderRouterAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VBR所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The VBR instance ID
parameters.help_zh: VBR实例ID。
parameters.name: vbr_id

parameters.help_en:
The VLAN ID of the VBR. Valid values: 0 to 2999. 

Only the owner of the Express Connect circuit can specify this parameter. The VLAN IDs of two VBRs on the same Express Connect circuit must be different
parameters.help_zh:
VBR的VLAN ID，取值范围：0～2999。 

只有物理专线的所有者可以指定该参数，同一条物理专线下的两个VBR的VLAN ID不能相同
parameters.name: vlan_id

parameters.help_en:
The circuit code provided by the carrier for the Express Connect circuit. 
          
Only the owner of the Express Connect circuit can specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
运营商为物理专线提供的电路编码。 
          
只有物理专线的所有者可以指定该参数。
parameters.name: circuit_code

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud-side IP address of the VBR instance.

This property can be specified or modified only by the VBR owner
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例的阿里云侧互联IP。

该属性只允许VBR所有者指定或修改
parameters.name: local_gateway_ip

parameters.help_en:
The client-side IP address of the VBR instance.

This property can be specified or modified only by the VBR owner
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例的客户侧互联IP。

该属性只允许VBR所有者指定或修改
parameters.name: peer_gateway_ip

parameters.help_en:
The subnet mask for the Alibaba Cloud-side and client-side IP addresses of the VBR instance. This property can be specified or modified only by the VBR owner.

The two IP addresses must be in the same subnet
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例的阿里云侧和客户侧互联IP的子网掩码。该属性只允许VBR所有者指定或修改。

两个IP地址必须位于同一个子网中
parameters.name: peering_subnet_mask

parameters.help_en: The alert interval for sending Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) packets. Valid values: 200 to 1000. Unit: ms
parameters.help_zh: 配置BFD报文的发送间隔，取值：200～1000，单位：ms
parameters.name: min_tx_interval

parameters.help_en: The receive interval of BFD packets. Valid values: 200 to 1000. Unit: ms
parameters.help_zh: 配置BFD报文的接收间隔，取值：200～1000，单位：ms
parameters.name: min_rx_interval

parameters.help_en:
The detection multiplier, which specifies the maximum number of consecutive packet losses allowed by the receiver from the sender. This parameter is used to detect whether the link is normal.

Valid values: 3 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
检测时间倍数，即接收方允许发送方发送报文的最大连接丢包数，用来检测链路是否正常。

取值：3～10
parameters.name: detect_multiplier

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VBR.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
VBR的描述信息。

长度为2～256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VBR.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
VBR的名称。

长度为2～128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The list of Express Connect circuits associated with the VBR, which contains the following parameters:

VlanId: The VLAN ID of the VBR instance.
CircuitCode: The circuit encoding provided by the carrier for the Express Connect circuit.
LocalGatewayIp: The Alibaba Cloud-side IP address of the VBR instance.
PeerGatewayIp: The client-side IP address of the VBR instance.
PeeringSubnetMask: The subnet mask for the Alibaba Cloud-side and client-side IP addresses of the VBR instance.
LocalIpv6GatewayIp: The Alibaba Cloud-side IPv6 address of the VBR instance.
PeerIpv6GatewayIp: The client-side IPv6 address of the VBR instance.
PeeringIpv6SubnetMask: The subnet mask for the Alibaba Cloud-side and client-side IPv6 addresses of the VBR instance.
ipv6Enable: Enables IPv6.
PhysicalConnectionId: The Express Connect circuit instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
VBR关联的物理专线的列表信息，包含以下参数：

VlanId：VBR实例的VLAN ID。
CircuitCode：运营商为物理专线提供的电路编码。
LocalGatewayIp：VBR实例的阿里云侧互联 IP。
PeerGatewayIp：VBR实例的客户侧互联 IP。
PeeringSubnetMask：VBR实例的阿里云侧和客户侧互联IP的子网掩码。
LocalIpv6GatewayIp：VBR实例的阿里云侧互联IPv6 地址。
PeerIpv6GatewayIp：VBR实例的客户侧互联IPv6 地址。
PeeringIpv6SubnetMask：VBR实例的阿里云侧和客户侧互联IPv6的子网掩码。
ipv6Enable：开启IPv6。
PhysicalConnectionId：物理专线实例ID
parameters.name: associated_physical_connections

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud-side IPv6 address of the VBR instance
parameters.help_zh: VBR实例的阿里云侧互联IPv6地址
parameters.name: local_ipv6_gateway_ip

parameters.help_en:
The client-side IPv6 address of the VBR instance.

This property can be specified or modified only by the VBR owner.

This parameter is required when the Express Connect circuit owner creates a VBR instance. It is not required when creating a VBR instance for another account
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例的客户侧互联IPv6地址。

该属性只允许VBR所有者指定或者修改。

为物理专线所有者创建VBR实例时必填，为其他账号创建VBR实例时无需填写
parameters.name: peer_ipv6_gateway_ip

parameters.help_en:
The subnet mask for the Alibaba Cloud-side and client-side IPv6 addresses of the VBR instance.

The two IPv6 addresses must be in the same subnet
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例的阿里云侧和客户侧互联IPv6的子网掩码。

两个IPv6地址必须位于同一个子网中
parameters.name: peering_ipv6_subnet_mask

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable IPv6. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false (default): Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用IPv6。

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_ipv6

parameters.help_en: The bandwidth value. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 带宽值。单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow inter-IDC service access. Valid values:

true: Allowed.

false (default): Not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许IDC间业务访问。

true：允许。

false（默认值）：不允许
parameters.name: sitelink_enable

parameters.help_en:
The MTU value supported by the VBR. Valid values: 1500 and 8500.
This value can be set only when the VBR is attached to an Express Connect Router (ECR). This value also affects all other VBRs and VPCs within the same ECR
parameters.help_zh:
VBR支持的MTU值，取值范围：1500和8500。
只有当VBR绑定到ECR上，才允许设置该值，该值还会影响同ECR内的其他所有VBR和VPC
parameters.name: mtu
